brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.evidence: Three half-depth bins installed: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half in a horizontal row.
Three Keyhole hanger accessories on the back faces: accessory:0#-1,0#3, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#2 - allowing wall mounting on screws.

Linear 3-cell arrangement with shallow half-depth bins suited to small spice containers, dressed with 3 terracotta pots XS props (prop:1, prop:2, prop:3) one per bin to demonstrate use; caps and joint bolts locked.

finish.summary: Built horizontal 3-cell spice rack with three half-depth bins and three keyhole hangers on rear faces for wall mounting, dressed with small pots to show spice-jar storage.

lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
